newsitem.title: USA: Ancor Communications signs partner pact.
newsitem.headline: Ancor Communications signs partner pact.

text.p: Ancor Communications Inc said Friday it signed a channel partner agreement with XS International Inc involving the purchase of $500,000 worth of Ancor network software.
Ancor said the agreement will strengthen its competitive position in the key video, post-production and multimedia markets, previously identified as a critical growth area.

Earlier Friday, it said it received an auditor's opinion raising questions about its ability to continue as a going concern. A company official said the warning was not unusual for a company at Ancor's stage of development.
Ancor develops networking software. Its shares were trading down 1-5/8 Friday at 4-1/4.
